sources.artofcraps: https://www.artofcraps.com/ (hop bet, horn bet, Iron Cross pages)
sources.ballys-ac: Bally's Atlantic City craps gaming guide (PDF): hardways on the hop, 30 to 1

terms.meaning: A two: one and one. A craps number on the come-out in Regular rules.
terms.srLabel: Aces, or snake eyes: a two

notes.crapless: In Crapless a come-out two is a point: "Aces, the point is two. Mark it!"

terms.meaning: A three: one and two. A craps number on the come-out in Regular rules.

notes.crapless: In Crapless a come-out three is a point: "Ace-deuce, point is three."

terms.meaning: A four made with one and three, not a pair. An easy four loses a Hard 4 bet.
A four made with two and two. It wins a Hard 4 bet.
A four, most often the hard four (two and two). Rhyming slang: "Little Joe from Kokomo."
terms.call: Little Joe, four the hard way!

terms.meaning: A five. Old table slang; you'll also hear just "fever".
A five, called so the table knows the Field loses: 5 isn't a Field number.
terms.srLabel: No field five: a five; the Field loses

terms.meaning: A six that isn't a pair (one-five or two-four). It loses a Hard 6 bet.
A six made with three and three. It wins a Hard 6 bet.
A six. Rhyming slang: "Jimmy Hicks from the sticks."
terms.call: Jimmy Hicks from the sticks, six!

terms.meaning: A seven, and the one-roll Any Seven bet (4 to 1, 16.67% edge). Players say "Big Red" so they don't say "seven" while the dice are out.
terms.srLabel: Big Red: seven, or the Any Seven bet

terms.meaning: An eight that isn't a pair (two-six or three-five). It loses a Hard 8 bet.
An eight made with four and four. It wins a Hard 8 bet. Also called a "square pair".
A nine. Rhyming slang; often just "Nina".
A nine. 9 sits in the middle of the Field numbers (2 3 4 9 10 11 12), so the Field wins.
terms.srLabel: Center field nine: a nine; the Field wins

terms.meaning: A ten made with four and six. It loses a Hard 10 bet.
A ten made with five and five. It wins a Hard 10 bet.
An eleven, and the one-roll bet on 11 (15 to 1). Dealers say "yo" so "eleven" isn't heard as "seven".
terms.call: Yo-leven! Yo pays fifteen to one.

notes.crapless: In Crapless an 11 on the come-out is a point, not a winner: "Yo, mark the eleven!"

terms.meaning: A twelve: six and six. A craps number on the come-out in Regular rules, where it pushes Don't Pass (bar 12).

notes.crapless: In Crapless a come-out twelve is a point: "Boxcars, the point is twelve."

terms.meaning: 2, 3 or 12. On a come-out roll it loses the Pass line ("crap out"); the shooter keeps the dice.
terms.call: Three craps, line away. Pay the don'ts.

notes.crapless: Crapless has no come-out craps: 2, 3, 11 and 12 become points.

terms.meaning: A 7 or 11 on the come-out. The Pass line wins at once.
terms.call: Seven, front line winner! Pay the line, take the don'ts.
terms.srLabel: Natural: seven or eleven on the come-out

notes.crapless: In Crapless only a 7 is a natural; an 11 sets a point.

terms.meaning: The main bet with the shooter. Wins on a come-out 7 or 11, loses on 2, 3 or 12, otherwise needs the point before a 7.

notes.crapless: Only a come-out 7 wins; every other number is a point.

terms.meaning: The bet against the shooter. Wins on a come-out 2 or 3, pushes on 12 ("bar 12"), and wins if a 7 comes before the point.

notes.crapless: Not in Crapless: there's no Don't side.

terms.meaning: Like a Pass line bet, made after the point is set. The next roll is its own come-out; a box number moves the bet to that number.
Like Don't Pass, made after the point is set. It moves behind the next box number and wins if a 7 comes first.
terms.call: Don't Come, down behind the four.

terms.meaning: An extra bet behind your Pass or Come bet once there's a point. It's paid at true odds: 0% house edge.

notes.bubble: Up to 3-4-5x in Regular; 3x on 2/3/11/12 in Crapless.
notes.table: 3-4-5x Standard; 5x and 10x in Premium. Odds aren't capped by the $500 table max.

terms.meaning: Odds behind a Don't Pass or Don't Come bet. You risk more to win less, at true odds: 0% house edge.
terms.call: Lay the odds behind the four.

notes.bubble: Bubble's LAY tab holds lay odds for Don't Pass / Don't Come. It's Regular only, hidden in Crapless. It isn't a Lay bet.
notes.table: Up to 6x the flat bet. Exempt from the $500 table max.

terms.meaning: A bet that a number rolls before a 7. Pays 9 to 5 on 4/10, 7 to 5 on 5/9, 7 to 6 on 6/8. Off on the come-out unless you turn it on.

notes.crapless: Crapless adds Place 2, 3, 11 and 12. Buy them instead: it costs less.

terms.meaning: Like a Place bet, but paid at true odds less a 5% commission on the win. On 4/10 and 5/9 it costs less than placing.

notes.bubble: Billy's Way (Bubble only) buys 4, 5, 9, 10 and places 6 and 8 in one tap.

terms.meaning: A bet that a 7 rolls before a number. Paid at true odds less a 5% commission on the win.

notes.bubble: Not in Bubble Craps. Bubble's LAY tab is lay odds on a Don't bet, not a Lay bet.
notes.table: Works on the come-out by default (T-30). Commission on wins only (Standard).

terms.meaning: The 5% fee on a Buy bet (and in Table Craps a Lay bet). In both apps it's taken only from a win.
terms.call: Buy the four, vig on the win.

notes.bubble: Buy commission only; there are no Lay bets in Bubble.
notes.table: Buy and Lay commission. Premium can charge it up front (T-5, T-7).

terms.meaning: A one-roll bet on 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11 or 12. Pays even money; 2 and 12 pay double. 5, 6, 7 and 8 lose.
terms.call: Nine, field roll! Pay the field.

terms.meaning: An even-money bet that a 6 (or 8) rolls before a 7. Placing the 6 or 8 pays 7 to 6 for the same win, so Big 6/8 costs more (9.09% vs 1.52%).

notes.bubble: Not in Bubble Craps. Place the 6 or 8 instead.
notes.table: Off by default; turn it on with the board toggle.

terms.meaning: A bet that 4, 6, 8 or 10 rolls as a pair before it rolls easy or a 7. Hard 4/10 pay 7 to 1; Hard 6/8 pay 9 to 1.

notes.bubble: They work on the come-out by default (B-10).
notes.table: They work on the come-out by default. Many casinos have them off on the come-out unless you call them on.

terms.meaning: A one-roll bet that the next roll is 2, 3 or 12. Pays 7 to 1.
A one-roll bet split four ways on 2, 3, 11 and 12. A 2 or 12 pays 30 to 1 on its part, a 3 or 11 pays 15 to 1; the other parts lose.

notes.bubble: Posted in $4 units.
notes.table: Posted in $4 units.

terms.meaning: A 5-unit Horn with the extra unit on one number you name, like "$5 horn high yo".

notes.bubble: There's no Horn high spot. Build it: a Horn plus one more unit on that Horn number.
notes.table: There's no Horn high spot. Build it: a Horn plus one more unit on that Horn number.

terms.meaning: A one-roll bet split between Any Craps and Eleven. One half pays on 2, 3 or 12 (7 to 1); the other pays on 11 (15 to 1).
terms.srLabel: C and E: craps and eleven

terms.meaning: A one-roll bet on one exact pair of dice, like "3-2 on the hop". Easy hops pay 15 to 1, hard hops 30 to 1.

notes.bubble: All 21 hops are on the left Side-bets screen. A winning hop stays up.
notes.table: All 21 hops are on the left Side-bets screen. A winning hop stays up.

terms.meaning: A one-roll bet that the next roll is one exact pair, like "eight the hard way on the hop". Pays 30 to 1. A Hardway bet waits several rolls; a hard hop is one roll.
terms.call: Eight the hard way, on the hop.

notes.bubble: Hard hops are in the hop grid. "Hop the hardways" (all four at once) isn't one button: bet each hard hop.
notes.table: Hard hops are in the hop grid. "Hop the hardways" (all four at once) isn't one button: bet each hard hop.

terms.meaning: A 5-unit one-roll bet: a Horn plus Any Seven. On a 7 it's about a push; on 2, 3, 11 or 12 one part pays.

notes.bubble: There's no World spot. Build it: a $4 Horn plus $1 on Big Red.
notes.table: There's no World spot. Build it: a $4 Horn plus $1 on Big Red.

terms.meaning: Side bets on rolling every number on one side before a 7. The app calls them Low Rolls (2-6), High Rolls (8-12) and Roll 'Em All (all ten). Any 7 loses.
terms.call: Low Rolls: one more to go.
terms.srLabel: A T S: All Tall Small

notes.bubble: 31 / 31 / 156 FOR 1, Regular and Crapless. Stays up after a hit.
notes.table: 31 / 31 / 156 FOR 1. Stays up after a hit.

terms.meaning: A side bet, made only before a new shooter's first roll, on how many different points the shooter makes before the seven-out. 4, 5 or 6 points pay 24, 249 or 999 to 1.
terms.call: Fire Bet's open: new shooter, before the first roll.

notes.table: Table Craps only. Under 4 points pays nothing; all six pays at once.

terms.meaning: A side bet that a number rolls a set number of times before a 7: twice for 2 or 12, up to six times for 6 or 8.
terms.call: Six, that's four of six on the repeater!

notes.bubble: 40 / 50 / 65 / 80 / 90 FOR 1. Any 7 loses, the come-out 7 too.
notes.table: 40 / 50 / 65 / 80 / 90 FOR 1. Any 7 loses, the come-out 7 too.

terms.meaning: One side bet that Hard 4, 6, 8 and 10 all roll before a 7. Easy numbers don't hurt it; only a 7 loses.
terms.call: Hard eight, that's three of four for Hard Way All Day!

notes.bubble: 165 FOR 1. Stays up after a win.
notes.table: 165 FOR 1. Stays up after a win.

terms.meaning: The bets in the middle of the table: Big Red, Any Craps, C&E, Horn, hops and hardways. Most are one-roll bets with high edges.
A Pass or Come bet after its point is set. You can't take it down or reduce it until it wins or loses.
terms.call: Pass line stays up: it's a contract bet.

terms.meaning: Make a winning bet bigger, often doubling it, using the win. More is at risk on a 7; the edge per bet doesn't change.
terms.call: Pressing your six, up to twelve.

notes.bubble: The PRESS key adds your original bet; POWER PRESS moves it to the next step of Bill's ladder.
notes.table: Done by hand (T9 Regression, T10 Press Progressions). There's no PRESS key in Table Craps.

terms.meaning: Leave a winning bet as it was and take the win. It's not a press.

notes.bubble: Paid bets stay up on their own; the win goes to your chips.
notes.table: Paid bets stay up on their own; the win goes to your rail.

terms.meaning: Make a bet smaller after it wins, like taking $18 on the 6 down to $6, so more of the win goes to your chips.
terms.call: Regress the six, down to six dollars.

notes.bubble: Strategy B5 teaches it.
notes.table: Strategy T9 teaches it.

terms.meaning: Remove a bet from the table and get the chips back. Place, Buy, odds and props can come down; Pass and Come flats can't.

notes.bubble: Taking down a Don't bet gives up its edge; Billy warns first.
notes.table: Taking down a Don't bet gives up its edge; Billy warns first.

terms.meaning: An Off bet stays on the felt but can't win or lose. Place and Buy bets are off on the come-out unless you turn them on.
terms.call: Your bets are off on the come-out.

notes.bubble: BETS OFF parks your Place and Buy bets.
notes.table: Place and Buy are off on the come-out (Premium T-9 can turn them on).

terms.meaning: A bet that's in play on this roll. "Odds working" asks for Come odds to work on a come-out roll.
Trade lots of small chips for fewer big ones when you leave the table.

notes.bubble: Live table only. Bubble Craps has no chip rail.
notes.table: The rail offers a color-up, and always colors up when you tap Leave table.

terms.meaning: Said when you lay cash on the felt for chips and don't want a bet. Dealers say it out loud so no one thinks it's a bet.

notes.bubble: Live table only: the app uses practice chips.
notes.table: Live table only: the app uses practice chips.

terms.meaning: Breaking a chip into smaller ones, like a $25 into five $5s. "Checks" is dealer talk for chips.

notes.bubble: Live table only.
notes.table: The rail makes change by itself, with a short "Change" animation.

terms.meaning: Telling the dealer a bet without putting chips down first. Many casinos won't book one; say it before the dice are out.
terms.call: No call bets, chips down please.

notes.bubble: Live table only: in the app every bet is chips on the felt.
notes.table: Live table only: in the app every bet is chips on the felt.

terms.meaning: Field plus Place 5, 6 and 8. Every total but 7 pays something, and a 7 loses it all.
terms.call: Iron Cross, you're covered on everything but seven.

notes.bubble: Bet it by hand: Field + Place 5, 6, 8.
notes.table: Strategy T7 ($44 Iron Cross).

terms.meaning: Buy 5 and 9 and Place 6 and 8, like "$44 inside" at a $10 table: Buy $10 on 5 and 9, Place $12 on 6 and 8.

notes.table: Strategy T6 ($44 Inside).

terms.meaning: Bets on 4, 5, 9 and 10. Buy 4 and 10 (and often 5 and 9) costs less than placing them.
Bets on all six box numbers: 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10, like "$32 across" at a $5 table.

notes.bubble: Billy's Way (Bubble only) covers every number in one tap: Buy 4, 5, 9, 10 + Place 6 and 8.
notes.table: Place each number; there's no Billy's Way key.

terms.meaning: Betting with the shooter: Pass, Come and their odds.
Betting against the shooter: Don't Pass, Don't Come, lay odds and Lay bets. It's allowed; the polite way is to win quietly.
The disc that shows the point. OFF (black side up) means a come-out roll is next. ON sits on the point number.
The first roll when no point is set. 7 or 11 wins the Pass line, 2, 3 or 12 loses, anything else sets the point.
terms.call: The point is six. Mark the six!

notes.crapless: Only a 7 wins on the come-out, and nothing loses.

terms.meaning: The stickman's call before a come-out roll, so everyone gets line bets down.

notes.bubble: No shooter in Bubble Craps: "New hand, coming out!"

terms.meaning: The number (4, 5, 6, 8, 9 or 10) set on the come-out. The shooter needs it again before a 7.
terms.call: Six! The point is made. Pass line wins.

notes.crapless: Crapless points can also be 2, 3, 11 or 12.

terms.meaning: A 7 while a point is on. The hand ends: Pass and number bets lose, and the Don'ts win.

notes.bubble: A come-out 7 is a winner, never a seven-out.
notes.table: Solo: you keep the dice. Pass & play: the dice pass to the left.

terms.meaning: "Point, seven out." Players use it for a hand that sets a point and sevens out quickly, often on the next roll.
terms.srLabel: P S O: point, seven out

notes.bubble: The app's PSO animation (S4.4) plays on every seven-out.
notes.table: The app's PSO animation (S4.4) plays on every seven-out.

terms.meaning: After a seven-out the dice go to the next player to the left, who can shoot or pass.

notes.bubble: No shooter in Bubble Craps: a seven-out just starts a new hand.
notes.table: Pass & play passes the dice; solo, you keep them.

terms.meaning: The player throwing the dice. They need a line bet down, throw with one hand, and hit the back wall.

notes.bubble: No shooter in Bubble Craps: the machine rolls.
notes.table: You're the shooter. Setting the dice is a practice ritual; it can't change a roll.

terms.meaning: The dealer with the long stick. Moves the dice, calls each roll and books the center bets. Dealer Billy plays this role.

notes.bubble: Live table role; Dealer Billy calls the rolls here.
notes.table: Live table role; Dealer Billy calls the rolls here.

terms.meaning: The casino supervisor seated between the base dealers. Watches the chips and the cash and settles disputes.

notes.bubble: Live table only.
notes.table: Live table only.

terms.meaning: Every roll from a come-out through the seven-out. A point made doesn't end it; only a seven-out does.
terms.call: What a roll, give the shooter a hand.
terms.callBubble: What a roll! That hand's over.

notes.bubble: The Blazing meter and Longest Roll count hands this way (S4.1).
notes.table: The Blazing meter counts hands this way (S4.1).

terms.meaning: Free food, rooms and the like a casino gives based on how much and how long you bet. Never worth betting more for.

notes.bubble: Live table only. The app has no comps, rewards or prizes.
notes.table: Live table only. The app has no comps, rewards or prizes.

terms.meaning: A tip for the dealers, often a small bet placed for them. Optional, and part of your budget.
terms.call: Thank you! That's a bet for the dealers.

notes.bubble: Live table only. There's no tip or toke bet in the app.
notes.table: Live table only. There's no tip or toke bet in the app.

terms.meaning: The groove around the table edge where you keep your chips. Only bets go on the felt.

notes.bubble: Live table only; Bubble uses the chip rack.
notes.table: Your rail shows chips that aren't bet.

terms.meaning: A throw that doesn't count, like a die off the table. Nothing is settled and the shooter throws again.

notes.bubble: Bubble Craps never has a no-roll.
notes.table: Practice no-rolls never count toward the hand.

terms.meaning: The call that the shooter has the dice. Bets are set, and hands come off the felt.

notes.bubble: At the machine, betting closes when you tap ROLL.
notes.table: Bets lock while the dice are out.

callMap._rule: Resolve from the settled roll object {d1,d2,total,hard,phaseBefore,result} only, in this order. Never re-derive from text.

rank: exact term or alias (also ignoring spaces)
whole-word substring, a 5+ char substring ignoring spaces, or every query word starts a word of the key ('nina pasadena')
same dice total as an exact hit
typo fallback only when nothing above matched: Damerau-Levenshtein <= 1 (4-6 chars) or <= 2 (7+ chars) against a whole term/alias or a word of 4+ letters, shown under 'Did you mean'
